svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

svg.text: Cut two halves of 55 m from the 120 m coil; tape and melt the ends

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Splice a soft eye 80 long round one swivel eye in each half; five tucks

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Lead each plain end round the other ring: round turn and two half hitches

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Set the length so the rings lie at the blocks when the loop is snug

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Seize the knot's tail and coil any surplus at the ring, never between rings

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: each ring turns freely on its swivel under a hand pull
